rejected_modules.reason: No structured story content is evidenced; themed quiz progression is sufficient.
No fictional cast, quest, or dialogue activity is in scope.
The product has no battle, party, action, or power-progression loop.
There is no builder, collection, or economy loop.
Football is trivia subject matter, not simulated sport or traversal.
Single-player is selected; connected mode and safety policy require approval.
Events and monetisation are deferred; operations, entitlements, and policy are unresolved.

design_units.title: Question-card grammar
source_evidence: INITIAL: multiple question formats and answer validation
design_units.first_release_boundary: Published original cards require prompt, answer rule, explanation, provenance, and two-editor approval.

design_units.title: Kickoff Mix catalogue batch
design_units.first_release_boundary: 48 cards in four 12-card reviewed batches with stated category/difficulty quotas.

design_units.title: Answer adjudication and provenance
design_units.player_outcome: Understand a fair accepted or rejected answer.
design_units.first_release_boundary: Deterministic ID/normalised-alias comparison only; no fuzzy matching or unreviewed source.

design_units.title: Freshness and editorial workflow
source_evidence: INITIAL: curated bank and local progress
design_units.first_release_boundary: Exclude last two completed-round cards where alternatives exist; versioned propose-to-publish workflow.

design_units.title: First Whistle tutorial round
design_units.player_outcome: Finish a first round and understand saving.
design_units.first_release_boundary: Five fixed named tutorial cards, non-timed, completable offline without sign-in.

design_units.title: Mixed Fixture standard round
source_evidence: INITIAL: quick sessions and themed rounds
design_units.first_release_boundary: One 10-card template with deterministic eligible selection and optional-off timer.

design_units.title: Score and streak rules
design_units.first_release_boundary: 100 base points; capped 3+ streak bonus; wrong/blank/timeout/abandon resets streak.

design_units.title: Result and local milestone
design_units.player_outcome: Know what was achieved and what to do next.
design_units.first_release_boundary: Results and first_whistle_complete only; no RPG levels, ranks, or social leaderboard.

design_units.title: Guided accessible start
design_units.player_outcome: Start and control the game with a chosen input method.
design_units.first_release_boundary: Local profile, tutorial entry, settings, and equivalent touch/pointer/keyboard/gamepad actions; no mandatory account.

design_units.title: Confirmed snapshot recovery
design_units.player_outcome: Return without silent loss after interruption or failure.
design_units.first_release_boundary: Confirmed local snapshots, write-failure UI, corrupt-draft choice, and confirmed local deletion; no remote sync.

design_units.title: Offline update and error path
design_units.player_outcome: Play cached content and recover safely from update/error states.
design_units.first_release_boundary: Cached batch is playable offline; updates apply between rounds; minimised optional diagnostics only.

design_units.title: Shared-core platform adaptation
design_units.player_outcome: Receive the same fair quiz on each selected target.
source_evidence: INITIAL: responsive web, PWA, Android, iOS
design_units.first_release_boundary: Rule/content/save parity; web inputs/responsive layout, PWA install/cache UX, phone touch adaptation only.
